set.body:
Goal: keep the graphics family a self-contained general plotting library and prepare it to live outside scalafim.

Evidence (already clean): the graphics core and all four backends import nothing outside scalafim.graphics (verified across main+test); the graphics crossProject has no dependsOn and no extra libraryDependencies (build.sbt:64-75); backends depend only on graphics; the sole inbound edge is domain modules depending ON graphics (build.sbt:198).

Acceptance: a guard test or build check that fails if any scalafim non-graphics import appears in the graphics stack; neutral naming plan (package/module names free of neuroimaging terms); a cross-publish story (own version, JVM+JS artifacts, four backends as separate artifacts) documented in a short plan note; module-relations/README kept in sync; the split remains a lift-and-shift, not a refactor. No neuroimaging coupling introduced by any tier issue.
set.title: Graphics: extraction-readiness — package the graphics stack as a standalone library
